responsibility: Defines the PowerPC VxWorks subtarget configuration for rs6000, covering both the older EABI-style environment and the newer VxWorks 7 Linux-like environment. It sets VxWorks-specific builtins, cpp specs, library/startfile/endfile/link behavior, stack-check policy, and numerous ABI, endian, and toolchain overrides, then conditionally specializes frame layout and defaults for pre-vx7 versus vx7 systems, making it the main OS adaptation header for VxWorks on PowerPC.
